text:
Which statement about the elements in Group I is correct?
A
Hydrogen is produced when Group I elements react with water.
B
Ions of Group I elements have a 1– charge.
C
Sodium is more reactive than potassium.
D
Solid sodium is a poor electrical conductor.

options.label: A
options.text: Hydrogen is produced when Group I elements react with water.

options.label: B
options.text: Ions of Group I elements have a 1– charge.

options.label: C
options.text: Sodium is more reactive than potassium.

options.label: D
options.text: Solid sodium is a poor electrical conductor.
